verdict: Sub-512 chat 15/15 legs token-AND-text identical to the pinned llama.cpp oracle plus 5/5 cross-engine prompt tokenization (all_pass true); >=512 windowed pack 9/9 legs identical at 606/1205/2403 prompt tokens with 3/3 prompt tokenization identical and ZERO flips (all_pass true); raw-decode committed as-is with all_pass false — depths 1 and 5 clean on 4/4, one reported mismatch is a tokenizer re-encode artifact on whitespace runs (true token streams identical), three depth-50 flips disclosed with measured gaps of which two are demonstrated ORACLE-side flips; the runnable CPU lane on the same 606-token prompt and the same oracle diverges at generated index 2 with the oracle scoring its token 1.667 nats below the token the resident lane and the oracle both emit; determinism byte-identical across two fresh serve processes including a 2403-token windowed leg
deviations: The runnable-lane divergence leg covers one windowed prompt at one depth only (that lane prefills 606 tokens in ~10.8 min). No perf claim and no speed comparison with llama.cpp is made or implied. Host paths redacted from the health snapshots. scripts/chat-parity-gemma3.mjs carries three Phase 4 receipt fixes in the same commit series (row-id default, --lane-label, node:http instead of the global fetch); none touches engine behaviour. The frozen runnable-lane bundle's sub-512 near-tie was not re-adjudicated on this host.
